Block.Name: STATS_ITEMS
Block.WhereClause:
WHERE ( (
 STATS_ITEMS.PORT_CD = :parameter.p_port_cd and STATS_ITEMS.STATS_ISN = :parameter.p_stats_isn

 SELECT 1
 FROM smpl_items, smpl_requests

 AND smpl_requests.rqst_nmr = smpl_items.rqst_nmr

 AND smpl_items.stats_item_isn = STATS_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN)
)

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'STI_TARIFF_OF_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH('خطأ في بند التعرفة النهائي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'STI_SDP_OLD_ITEM_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك السابق', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'STI_SCND_FP_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جمرك البيان الثاني', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'STI_ICA_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'ICA_IDNT_ISN' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'STI_FP_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جمرك البيان الأول', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'STI_CUR_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH('خطأ في نوع عملة الصنف', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_WIDTH
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Width IS
 Shift number;
 ret number;
 ENTER_POS number;
 EXECUTE_POS number;
 OK_POS number;
 CANCEL_POS number;

BEGIN
 if :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH < 4 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أقل من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 elsif :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH > 8.2 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أكبر من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 else
 Shift := 1.75 - ((:PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH - 4)/2);
 ENTER_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS);
 EXECUTE_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS);
 CANCEL_POS:= Get_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS);
 OK_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS);

 Set_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS, ENTER_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS, EXECUTE_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS, CANCEL_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS, OK_POS-Shift);

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_HEIGHT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Height IS
 V_HEIGHT number;
 SHIFT number;
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT <= 12 THEN
 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (12 - :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT) * 0.25;
 V_HEIGHT := V_HEIGHT - SHIFT;

 :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS := :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS - SHIFT;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT > 12 AND :PARAMETER.TARIFF_LOV = 0 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('لا يمكن عرض أكثر من 12 صف من البيانات','INFORMATION');
 ELSE
 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (:PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT - 12) * 0.25;
 V_HEIGHT := V_HEIGHT + SHIFT;

 :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS := :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS + SHIFT;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);

 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'STITMS_UK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'TARIFF_CODE,PORT_CD,ITEM_ISN' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSE
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

 v_rqst_dt DATE;
 v_impr_nbr NUMBER (10);
 v_inspctr_nbr NUMBER (5);
 v_smpl_nbr NUMBER (4);
 v_smpl_exists NUMBER (4);
 v_smpl_ins NUMBER (4);
 actv_type NUMBER ;
BEGIN
 v_smpl_exists := 0;
 v_smpl_ins := 0;
 BEGIN
 v_rqst_dt := hijdate.cur_hij_date;
 --SELECT NVL (impr_expr_nbr, agent_nbr), insptr_id -- ask hatem about agent_nbr field in stats_dcltns table
 SELECT impr_expr_nbr, insptr_nbr
 INTO v_impr_nbr, v_inspctr_nbr
 FROM stats_dcltns
 WHERE port_cd = :parameter.p_port_cd
 AND stats_isn = :parameter.p_stats_isn
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 --
 BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK ('STATS_ITEMS');
 GO_ITEM ('STATS_ITEMS.ITEM_SEQ');
 LAST_RECORD;
 v_rec := :SYSTEM.cursor_record;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 FOR i IN 1 .. v_rec LOOP
 IF :chk_ok = 1 THEN
 BEGIN
 v_count := 0;
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM smpl_items, smpl_requests
 WHERE smpl_requests.rqst_port_cd = smpl_items.rqst_port_cd
 AND smpl_requests.rqst_nmr = smpl_items.rqst_nmr
 AND smpl_requests.rqst_dt = smpl_items.rqst_dt
 AND smpl_requests.rqst_port_cd = :parameter.p_port_cd
 AND smpl_requests.stats_isn = :parameter.p_stats_isn
 AND smpl_requests.lab_cd = :parameter.p_lab_cd
 AND smpl_items.stats_item_isn = :item_isn
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 --
 IF NVL (v_count, 0) = 0 THEN
 IF v_smpl_exists = 0 THEN
 BEGIN
 v_count := 0;
 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO v_count
 FROM smpl_requests
 WHERE smpl_requests.rqst_port_cd = :parameter.p_port_cd
 AND smpl_requests.stats_isn = :parameter.p_stats_isn
 AND smpl_requests.lab_cd = :parameter.p_lab_cd
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 ----
 IF NVL (v_count, 0) = 0 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT rqst_nmr.NEXTVAL
 INTO v_rqst_nmr
 FROM DUAL
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 ----
 IF NVL (v_rqst_nmr, 0) = 0 THEN
 v_rqst_nmr := 1;
 END IF;
 ----
 INSERT INTO smpl_requests
 (
 rqst_port_cd,
 rqst_nmr,
 rqst_dt,
 rqst_status_cd,
 stats_isn,
 impr_nbr,
 lab_cd,
 dcltn_type,
 inspctr_nbr,
 REGISTER_TYPE
 )
 VALUES
 (
 :parameter.p_port_cd,
 v_rqst_nmr,
 v_rqst_dt,
 0,
 :parameter.p_stats_isn,
 v_impr_nbr,
 :parameter.p_lab_cd,
 2,
 v_inspctr_nbr,
 1
 )
 ;
 ----
 v_smpl_ins := 1;
 IF activity.add_activity (5,
 1,
 1,
 :parameter.p_port_cd
 || '!'
 || v_rqst_nmr
 || '!'
 || v_rqst_dt
 ) = FALSE THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 v_smpl_exists := 1;
 ELSE
 v_smpl_exists := 1;
 IF NVL (v_rqst_nmr, 0) = 0 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT smpl_requests.rqst_nmr,
 smpl_requests.rqst_dt
 INTO v_rqst_nmr,
 v_rqst_dt
 FROM smpl_requests
 WHERE smpl_requests.rqst_port_cd = :parameter.p_port_cd
 AND smpl_requests.stats_isn = :parameter.p_stats_isn
 AND smpl_requests.lab_cd =:parameter.p_lab_cd
 AND ROWNUM = 1
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ----------
 BEGIN
 SELECT MAX (smpl_nbr) + 1
 INTO v_smpl_nbr
 FROM smpl_items
 WHERE rqst_port_cd = :parameter.p_port_cd
 AND rqst_nmr = v_rqst_nmr
 AND rqst_dt = v_rqst_dt
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 NULL;
 END;
 IF NVL (v_smpl_nbr, 0) = 0 THEN
 v_smpl_nbr := 1;
 END IF;
 ----
 INSERT INTO smpl_items
 (
 rqst_port_cd,
 rqst_nmr,
 rqst_dt,
 smpl_nbr,
 smpl_status,
 smpl_desc,
 smpl_mark,
 pkg_cd,
 smpl_qty,
 smpl_wgt,
 wgt_unit_cd,
 product_dt,
 expiry_dt,
 result_cd,
 action_cd,
 action_qty,
 action_doc_nbr,
 action_doc_dt,
 smpl_remarks,
 dcltn_item_isn,
 stats_item_isn,
 radiant_flag,
 smpl_doc_nbr,
 smpl_doc_path,
 smpl_doc_usr,
 smpl_doc_add_dt
 )
 VALUES
 (
 :parameter.p_port_cd,
 v_rqst_nmr,
 v_rqst_dt,
 v_smpl_nbr,
 0,
 SUBSTR(:item_desc,1,50),
 NULL,
 38,
 1,
 1,
 0, -- wgt_unit_cd = 0 insted of 7 -- nasser
 :prod_dt,
 :expiry_dt,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 :item_isn,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL,
 NULL
 )
 ;
 --
 IF activity.add_activity (5,
 3,
 1,
 :parameter.p_port_cd
 || '!'
 || v_rqst_nmr
 || '!'
 || v_rqst_dt
 || '!'
 || v_smpl_nbr
 ) = FALSE THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ----
 IF :system.last_record <> 'TRUE' THEN
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;
 --
 IF v_smpl_ins = 1 THEN
 smpl.put_rqst_status_cd (:parameter.p_port_cd, v_rqst_nmr, v_rqst_dt);
 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 END IF;
 --
 actv_type := 101; -- new activity added by eng hatem on hq environment
 --
 msg_lvl := :SYSTEM.message_level;
 :SYSTEM.message_level := '25';
 --
 IF v_smpl_ins = 1 THEN
 IF activity.add_activity (21,
 1,
 actv_type,
 :parameter.p_port_cd
 || '!'
 || :parameter.p_stats_isn
 ) = FALSE THEN
 RAISE form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 FORMS_DDL ('COMMIT');
 v_msg :=
 'تم إنشاء طلب تحليل عينات رقم '
 || v_rqst_nmr
 || ' وتاريخ '
 || TO_CHAR (v_rqst_dt, 'mi-mm-yyyy')
 || ' ';
 str.dispalert (v_msg,'INFORMATION');
 END IF;
 DO_KEY ('exit_form');
 DO_KEY ('exit_form');
 :SYSTEM.message_level := msg_lvl;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
 DECLARE
 errnum NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 errtxt VARCHAR2(80) := ERROR_TEXT;
 errtyp VARCHAR2(20) := ERROR_TYPE;
 alert_is alert;
 alert_button number;
 MsgTxt VARCHAR2(2000);

 BEGIN
 IF errnum = 41051 then
 null;
 else
 IF errtyp = 'FRM' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ش';
 ELSIF errtyp = 'ORA' THEN
 errtyp := 'خطأ : ق';
 END IF;

 IF DBMS_ERROR_CODE = ERR_DB.GET_DB_ERR_CD THEN
 MsgTxt := ERR_DB.GET_LAST_ERROR;
 ELSE
 MsgTxt := errtyp||'-'||TO_CHAR(errnum)||': '||errtxt;
 END IF;
 alert_is := find_alert('CFG_ERROR');

 if (not id_null(alert_is)) then
 set_alert_property(alert_is, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, MsgTxt );
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_is);
 else
 Message(MsgTxt);
 end if;

 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
end if;
 END;

Trigger.Name: ON-MESSAGE
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$TES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
 DECLARE

 msgtyp VARCHAR2(20) := MESSAGE_TYPE;
 BEGIN
 IF msgtyp = 'FRM' THEN
 msgtyp := 'معلومه : ش';
 ELSIF msgtyp = 'ORA' THEN
 msgtyp := 'معلومه : ق';
 END IF;


 Message(msgtyp||'-'||TO_CHAR(msgnum)||': '||msgtxt);

 END;

/* CGHP$CALL_HELP_FORM */
/* Call the help system after setting globals with current block and item */
BEGIN
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := '';
 IF (:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE IS NULL) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(23, 'Help file is missing or incorrect'), 'W', 'OFG', 23);
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE := :GLOBAL.CG$HP_HPATH || '';
 BEGIN
 CGHP$CALL_MS_HELP(
 0 /* IN : Help Context Id */
 ,:GLOBAL.CG$HP_HFILE); /* IN : Help Resource File */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;
